recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid white #FFFFFF.
2. Place the title 'Example:  Distance without Normalization' spanning the top of the slide (~5-20% of slide height, full width): the largest text on the slide, bold sans-serif, dark red #B00020, with the word 'without' underlined.
3. Place the slide-number badge in the top-right corner: a circle filled yellow #F0E68C with a black #000000 outline, containing the black number '53'.
4. Draw the content frame: a thin dark-red #A00000 rectangle border enclosing the middle band of the slide (~25-95% of slide height, full width with side margins); all remaining elements go inside this frame.
5. Inside the frame at the top-left, place the section header 'Feature Vector  of bars:' in bold black #000000.
6. Along the left edge inside the frame, place two small bold black #000000 row labels: 'Weight (KG)' aligned to the top row of numbers and 'Length (cm)' aligned to the bottom row of numbers.
7. Place the Red Class column group in the upper-middle of the frame: bold red #C00000 header 'Red Class' with three parenthesized vertical vectors below it in red #C00000, medium size (top number = Weight, bottom number = Length): (2 over 100), (3 over 150), (4 over 200).
8. Place the Blue Class column group to the right of Red Class: bold blue #0000CC header 'Blue Class' with three parenthesized vertical vectors in blue #0000CC: (7 over 150), (8 over 200), (9 over 250).
9. Place the Green Class column group to the right of Blue Class: bold green #2E8B22 header 'Green Class' with three parenthesized vertical vectors in green #2E8B22: (12 over 150), (13 over 250), (14 over 300).
10. Place the Test column group to the right of Green Class: bold black #000000 header 'Test' with one parenthesized vertical vector in black #000000: (7 over 120).
11. Below the vector grid, place the caption 'Squared distance between each vector and test vector' in black #000000.
12. Below the caption, place the red distance group at middle-left of the frame: parenthesized '(425   916   6409)' in red #C00000, numbers slightly smaller than the vector numbers.
13. Place the blue distance group to the right of the red group: parenthesized '(900   6401   16904)' in blue #0000CC, same size as step 12.
14. Place the green distance group to the right of the blue group: parenthesized '(925   16936   32449)' in green #2E8B22, same size as step 12.
15. Draw a yellow #E8D44D circle around the value '425' in the red distance group (the smallest squared distance).
16. Place the result box in the bottom-right inside the frame: a pale yellow #F5F5DC rounded rectangle containing the parenthesized vertical vector (7 over 100) in black #000000, followed by bold black text 'Belongs to   Red Class' with the words 'Red Class' in bold red #C00000.
